title: The model method: bar models for word problems
subject: math

doNow.prompt: Sam draws a bar model for 1 unit and 2 units. He draws the unit boxes in any lengths he likes, guessing the sizes, so his 2-unit bar is not twice his 1-unit bar. What is wrong with Sam's model?

choices.text: Nothing: a bar model is only a rough sketch
choices.misconception: Drawing unit boxes in any lengths, guessing the sizes.

rationale.chose: The learner selected option Nothing: a bar model is only a rough sketch as their answer to this question.
rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of drawing every unit box the same length.
rationale.reteach: Reteach from the paired notes trap: Drawing unit boxes in any lengths, guessing the sizes.. The bar is treated as a rough sketch rather than a scale model. Every unit box must be exactly the same length: two units is exactly twice one unit. In the animation scene s4 the ruler proves Sam's units do not match, while the correct 2-unit bar is exactly twice the 1-unit bar.
